testTitle: UPSC CSAT: Advanced Visual Reasoning Test

questions.q_en:
Select the figure that will complete the matrix series following the rule of rotation and addition of elements:

?
questions.q_hi:
उस आकृति का चयन करें जो रोटेशन और तत्वों के जुड़ाव के नियम का पालन करते हुए मैट्रिक्स श्रृंखला को पूरा करेगी:

(ऊपर दिया गया चित्र देखें)
options_en: <svg width='50' height='50'><line x1='15' y1='15' x2='35' y2='35' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='35' cy='35' r='3' fill='black'/></svg>
<svg width='50' height='50'><line x1='15' y1='15' x2='35' y2='35' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='15' cy='15' r='3' fill='black'/><circle cx='35' cy='35' r='3' fill='black'/></svg>
<svg width='50' height='50'><line x1='35' y1='15' x2='15' y2='35' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='15' cy='35' r='3' fill='black'/><circle cx='35' cy='15' r='3' fill='black'/></svg>
<svg width='50' height='50'><line x1='15' y1='15' x2='35' y2='35' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='25' cy='25' r='3' fill='black'/></svg>
questions.explanation: Row Logic: Step 1 (Line only), Step 2 (Line + 1 Dot at start), Step 3 (Line + 2 Dots at both ends). The orientation rotates 45 degrees clockwise in each new row. In the 3rd row, the diagonal needs 2 dots at both ends.

questions.q_en:
Select the figure that is related to the third figure in the same way as the second figure is related to the first figure (Analogy):

: :: :
?
questions.q_hi:
उस आकृति का चयन करें जो तीसरी आकृति से उसी प्रकार संबंधित है जैसे दूसरी आकृति पहली आकृति से संबंधित है (सादृश्य):

(ऊपर दिया गया चित्र देखें)
options_en: <svg width='50' height='50'><polygon points='25,5 45,40 5,40' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='25' cy='25' r='5' fill='black'/></svg>
<svg width='50' height='50'><rect x='10' y='10' width='30' height='30' fill='black'/></svg>
questions.explanation: The relationship is 'Outline to Solid Fill'. The square outline becomes a solid black square. Similarly, the triangle outline must become a solid black triangle.

questions.explanation: The pattern adds 'arms' or branches to the central vertical line in a clockwise manner starting from Top-Right. Sequence: Top-Right -> Bottom-Right -> Bottom-Left. The next logical addition is Top-Left to complete the X shape logic.
